description: This PHP source file defines the 'LeaveListController' class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages the leave list view for the application, handling data preparation and component rendering, including leave statuses, types, date filters, and employee information.

classes.name: LeaveListController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the leave list view, assembling data such as leave statuses, types, employee info, and date range filters to be rendered in the associated Vue component.
